extracted.stage: Before grant of probate; inheritance tax payable
extracted.summary: An executor of her late father's estate, mostly a £425,000 house in Cheltenham, asks to borrow about £73,000 to pay inheritance tax before the grant of probate is issued.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding the inheritance tax due on your late father's estate. We have noted that the estate is largely a property in Cheltenham valued at around £425,000, that approximately £73,000 of inheritance tax is payable, and that Mercer & Pemberton Legal are instructed. To take this further we would need a copy of the will and confirmation of your appointment as executor, a breakdown of the estate's assets and liabilities, the HMRC inheritance tax figures and any payment deadline, and your solicitor's written confirmation that they are acting. Once we have those documents a member of our team will review the matter and come back to you. Nothing in this email should be taken as an offer or an indication that funding will be available.
